# precedence lower

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:precedenceLower`](gmeow-precedenceLower.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/precedenceLower>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The norm that yields during this tenure. Functional, and distinct from [`precedenceHigher`](gmeow-precedenceHigher.md) (SHACL).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:precedenceLower`](gmeow-precedenceLower.md) from [`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md), [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md) to name the single norm that yields during the tenure.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one yielding norm (it is functional) and avoid pointing it at the prevailing norm — it must differ from [`gmeow:precedenceHigher`](gmeow-precedenceHigher.md) (SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:precedenceLower`](gmeow-precedenceLower.md) once from the tenure to the yielding norm, paired with a distinct [`gmeow:precedenceHigher`](gmeow-precedenceHigher.md) and a [`gmeow:precedenceScope`](gmeow-precedenceScope.md).

- ex:pt1 [`gmeow:precedenceLower`](gmeow-precedenceLower.md) ex:xN.
